Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Complete production-ready implementation

This commit makes the aether-site-exporter plugin fully production-ready with complete backend and frontend functionality.

Backend Changes:
- Added URLDiscoveryService for comprehensive URL discovery (posts, pages, categories, tags, archives, etc.)
- Added HTTPClient utility for consistent HTTP request handling
- Implemented all ExportStepsController endpoints (discover URLs, generate blueprint, create archive, cleanup)
- Implemented DownloadController with secure file serving and path validation
- Added file deletion to ExportJobController delete_job endpoint
- Fixed database schema to use varchar for job IDs instead of AUTO_INCREMENT
- Updated StaticSiteGenerator to use URLDiscoveryService and HTTPClient
- Removed database converter functionality (to be re-added separately if needed)

Frontend Changes:
- Complete React export interface with full API integration
- Export configuration form with target URL input
- Real-time progress tracking via polling
- Job history table with download links
- Delete job functionality with confirmation
- Comprehensive error handling and user feedback
- Form validation

Documentation:
- Added comprehensive README.md with:
  - Features overview
  - Installation and usage instructions
  - Complete REST API documentation
  - Architecture overview
  - File structure
  - Database schema
  - Export workflow description
  - Troubleshooting guide

Security Improvements:
- Path validation in download endpoints to prevent directory traversal
- Realpath checks to ensure files are within exports directory
- All REST endpoints require manage_options capability

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Add automatic cleanup service and WP-CLI commands

Added comprehensive cleanup functionality with automatic scheduling and WP-CLI support.

New Features:
- CleanupService for managing old export files and jobs
- Automatic daily cleanup via WordPress cron (removes jobs older than 30 days)
- WP-CLI commands for manual cleanup and statistics
  - wp aether-exporter cleanup (with --days and --dry-run options)
  - wp aether-exporter cleanup-failed (removes failed jobs)
  - wp aether-exporter stats (view disk usage and job statistics)
- Proper cron event cleanup on plugin deactivation

Services:
- CleanupService with methods for:
  - cleanup_old_jobs() - Remove jobs older than X days
  - cleanup_failed_jobs() - Remove failed jobs older than X hours
  - get_statistics() - Get disk usage and job statistics
  - Calculates freed disk space

CLI Commands:
- Full WP-CLI integration with detailed help text
- Dry-run mode for previewing deletions
- Customizable retention periods
- Statistics display

Documentation:
- Updated README with WP-CLI command documentation
- Added automatic cleanup section
- Documented all cleanup features and options

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
